title: Economist breaks down new inflation report and what's driving prices higher
summary: Credit-union economist on the September 2026 CPI: half the jump is fuel, the rest is broad-based, real wages are flat since 2025 and lower-income households are leaning on credit.

assertions.quote: Half of it is coming from the high gas and diesel prices
the war in Iran is not causing medical care, dental care, toys, apparel. I hope nobody's shopping for a suit. Those really jumped up.
There's been no wage growth once you adjust for inflation
this is more than a gas and oil problem and that it's going to be harder to get it down than we expected
people in the bottom 30% don't have any extra money and are relying on credit cards and starting to miss payments

verdicts.note: Credit card and auto delinquency rates rose through 2025-26, concentrated among lower-income and younger borrowers.
